 Here are the Cricket Predictions for the Women's Big Bash League 2026 - 24th Match - Sydney Thunder Women vs Melbourne Stars Women, to be played on the 16th of November at the Drummoyne Oval, Sydney.
 Match Prediction - Sydney Thunder Women v Melbourne Stars Women 
 LIVE SCORES - 24th Match - Sydney Thunder Women vs Melbourne Stars Women (Drummoyne Oval, Sydney) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Drummoyne Oval, Sydney (Women's Big Bash League) - 128
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Drummoyne Oval, Sydney (Women's Big Bash League) - 119
 Current Form Sydney Thunder Women: 
 Sydney Thunder Women are currently placed at the 6th position on points table with 2 wins, 3 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. Their NRR is 0.215.
 The top run scorer for Sydney Thunder Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Heather Knight with 187 runs to her name .
 The top wicket taker for Sydney Thunder Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Georgia Voll with 6 scalps under her belt.
 Sydney Thunder Women have lost their previous match against Perth Scorchers Women by 4 wickets.
 Sydney Thunder Women batted first and they posted a total of 159 for 5 in 20 overs. Phoebe Litchfield and Georgia Voll got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Anika Learoyd and Heather Knight played to their potential, scoring 53 and 71 runs respectively. On the back of their resolve with the bat, Sydney Thunder Women managed to get to 159 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Perth Scorchers Women lost the key wicket of Ines Mckeon quite early. After her dismissal, Katie Mack and Sophie Devine revived the innings with knocks of 31 and 37 runs respectively. Mikayla Hinkley and Chloe Piparo also played to their potential in the middle order. Both made 24 important runs and helped Perth Scorchers Women get over the line in the 19th over with 4 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Melbourne Stars Women: 
 Melbourne Stars Women on the other hand are currently placed at the 7th position on points table with 1 win and 5 losses to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.602.
 The top run scorer for Melbourne Stars Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Meg Lanning with 254 runs to her name.
 The top wicket taker for Melbourne Stars Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Annabel Sutherland with 7 scalps under her belt.
 Melbourne Stars Women have lost their previous match against Brisbane Heat Women by 8 wickets.
 Melbourne Stars Women batted first and they posted a total of 165 for 5 in 20 overs. Meg Lanning and Amy Jones played really well at the top. Lanning made 52 off 45 balls while Jones went on to score 74 runs in only 52 deliveries. The rest of the batters failed to capitalise on the momentum that was formed and they had to settle for a total of 165, even though at one point, they were aiming at 180+.
 During the chase, Brisbane Heat Women lost the key wicket of Grace Harris quite early. However, after her dismissal, Georgia Redmayne and Orla Prendergast took the responsibility of taking Brisbane Heat Women home. Redmayne scored 74 runs off 50 balls while Prendergast smashed 52 off 36 deliveries. Both stayed not out and helped Brisbane Heat Women get over the line in the 19th over with 8 wickets in hand.
